name: Pangolin Addon (CLI)
description: Installs the official Pangolin CLI on the Proxmox host and/or one or more existing LXCs and runs Site mode (`pangolin up site`) and/or Machine Client mode (`pangolin up client`).

notes.text: Run on the Proxmox host. Installs go to the host and/or Debian 12+/Ubuntu 22.04+/Alpine 3.20+ LXCs (var_targets). A host install joins the whole host to the VPN; prefer an LXC.
Site: a static Site ID must be unique per connector. A provisioning key (tier3/enterprise) creates one distinct site per use; unattended needs "approve new sites" on.
Components: Site tunnel (userspace WireGuard) and Machine client. Client or native mode needs /dev/net/tun (LXC passthrough added). Create the client in the dashboard first.
Multi-site: var_sites lists up to 8 slug-keyed connectors per target. Native interfaces default to pang<slug>/pangm<slug>. var_site_ssh_owner ("default") alone keeps SSH.
A single-site install converts on its first extra slug, one-way, and stays template-based: `systemctl status pangolin-site@<slug>` / `rc-service pangolin-site-<slug> status`.
Unattended: var_mode=site var_targets=101,102 var_pangolin_endpoint=URL var_sites="orga" var_site_id_orga_101=ID var_site_secret_orga_101=SECRET. Creds take slug/target suffixes.
